lines.text: Many learners say: My sister is a nurse, and he works at night.
Better: My sister is a nurse, and she works at night.
A woman is she, not he.
She! My mother is kind, and she helps me.

data.wrong: My sister is a nurse, and he works at night.
data.right: My sister is a nurse, and she works at night.
data.why: A woman is she, not he.

quiz.stem: My mother is kind, and ___ helps me.

native.tip: हिंदी में “वह” पुरुष और स्त्री दोनों के लिए चलता है, इसलिए he/she में गड़बड़ी हो जाती है; बहन के लिए she बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “My sister is a nurse, and he works at night.” 😅 सही रूप है “My sister is a nurse, and she works at night.” क्योंकि स्त्री के लिए she आता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “she”। अब इसी तरह अपना एक वाक्य लिखिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: One Hindi word covers he and she, so learners mix them; use she for a woman.
en.caption: Do you say this? “My sister is a nurse, and he works at night.” 😅 The right way is “My sister is a nurse, and she works at night.” This is right because a woman is she. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
